summary: 研究者借法国出土的科利尼历法和其他铭文重建凯尔特语族谱，并推算不同分支分开的时间。结果涉及凯尔特语传入不列颠的年代，也引发了对语言变化速率和定年方法的质疑。
logic: 古历法保存高卢语词汇

paragraphs.brief: 法国出土的高卢语青铜历表
sentences: In November 1897, in a field near the village of Coligny in eastern France, a local inhabitant unearthed two strange objects.
1897年11月，在法国东部Coligny村附近的一个田地上，一名当地居民挖掘出两件奇怪的东西。
One was an imposing statue of Mars, the Roman god of war.
其中一件是罗马战神马尔斯的威武雕像。
The other was an ancient bronze tablet, 1.5 metres wide and 1 metre high.
另一件是一块古代青铜板，宽1.5米、高1米。
It bore numerals in Roman but the words were in Gaulish, a version of the Celtic language spoken by the inhabitants of France before the Roman conquest in the first century BC.
板上用罗马数字记数，文字却是高卢语。这是一种凯尔特语言，在公元前一世纪罗马征服这一地区之前，今天法国一带的居民曾使用它。
The tablet turned out to be one of the most important sources of words from this extinct language.
这块青铜板后来成为了解这种已消亡语言词汇的最重要资料之一。
paragraphs.gist: 1897年法国科利尼出土一块兼用罗马数字与高卢语文字的青铜历表，成为研究这种已消亡的凯尔特语言的重要词汇来源。

paragraphs.brief: 凯尔特语的扩散与现存语支
sentences: Two researchers, geneticist Dr Peter Forster and linguist Dr Alfred Toth, have now used the calendar and other Celtic inscriptions to reconstruct the history of Celtic and its position in the Indo-European family of languages.
遗传学家彼得·福斯特博士和语言学家阿尔弗雷德·托特博士，利用这份历表和其他凯尔特语铭文，重建了凯尔特语的历史及其在印欧语系中的位置。
They say that Celtic became a language in its own right and entered the British Isles much earlier than supposed.
他们认为，凯尔特语独立形成、传入不列颠群岛的时间都比原先设想的早得多。

Then in the first century BC, the Romans defeated the Celts, both in France and in Britain, so decisively that their language, Latin, and its successor languages displaced Celtic over much of its former territory.
公元前一世纪，罗马人在法国和不列颠击败凯尔特人，占据绝对优势；在原先许多使用凯尔特语的地方，拉丁语及其后继语言逐渐取而代之。

In the British Isles, Celtic speakers survived in two main groups: the Goidelic branch of Celtic, which includes Irish and Scots Gaelic, and the Brythonic branch, formed mainly of Welsh and Breton, a Celtic tongue carried to Brittany in France by emigrants from Cornwall.
在不列颠群岛，凯尔特语使用者主要分成两支而延续下来：盖尔语支包括爱尔兰语和苏格兰盖尔语，布立吞语支主要包括威尔士语和布列塔尼语，后者由康沃尔移民带到法国布列塔尼。
paragraphs.gist: 福斯特与托特借历表和其他铭文重建凯尔特语史，认为它独立并进入不列颠较早；拉丁语扩张后，岛上主要保留两大语支。

paragraphs.brief: 借遗传学方法建立语言树
sentences: Because languages change so fast, historical linguists have little faith in language trees that go back more than a few thousand years.
由于语言变化很快，历史语言学家对回溯数千年以上的语言谱系树缺乏信心。
Dr Forster has developed a new method for relating a group of languages, basing it on the tree-drawing techniques used to trace the evolutionary relationships among genes.
福斯特博士提出一种判断一组语言亲缘关系的新方法，借鉴了遗传学中用树状图追踪基因演化关系的技术。
The method will work on just a handful of words, a fortunate circumstance since only some 30 Gaulish words have known counterparts in all the other languages under study.
这一方法只需要少数词汇就能运作，恰好适用于这里：只有约三十个高卢语词，在所研究的其他所有语言中都能找到已知的对应词。

Dr Forster and Dr Toth have used the method to draw up a tree relating the different branches of Celtic to one another and to other Indo-European languages like English, French, Spanish, Latin and Greek.
两位研究者用这种方法绘制了一棵谱系树，展示凯尔特语各分支之间，以及它们与英语、法语、西班牙语、拉丁语和希腊语等其他印欧语言的关系。

In a published article, they say that soon after the ancestral Indo-European language arrived in Europe over 5,000 years ago, it split into different branches leading to Celtic, Latin, Greek and English.
他们在一篇已发表的论文中指出，5,000 多年前，原始印欧语传入欧洲后不久便分化成不同支系，后来形成了凯尔特语、拉丁语、希腊语和英语。

Within Celtic, their tree shows that Gaulish – the mainland European version of the language – separated from its Goidelic and Brythonic cousins, much as might be expected from the facts of geography.
在凯尔特语内部，这棵树显示，欧洲大陆的高卢语与同属一家的盖尔语支和布立吞语支分化开来，这与依据地理位置作出的预期大体相符。
paragraphs.gist: 福斯特借用遗传学的建树方法，仅凭约三十个可跨语言比较的高卢语词追溯亲缘，所得大陆与岛屿分支也与地理格局相符。

paragraphs.brief: 分支年代与估计的不确定性
sentences: The researchers’ method even dates the points at which their language tree divides, although the dates have a wide range of possibility.
这种方法甚至可以推算语言树上各分支出现的年代，不过估算范围较大。

They calculate that the Indo- European language initially fragmented in Europe around 8100 BC, plus or minus 1,900 years, and the divergence between the mainland European and British versions of Gaelic took place in 3200 BC, plus or minus 1,500 years.
他们推算，印欧语在欧洲首次分化约在公元前8100年，上下浮动1900年；欧洲大陆与不列颠的盖尔语变体约在公元前3200年分化，上下浮动1500年。
These dates are much earlier than previously estimated.
这些日期比以前估计的要早得多。
The traditional date of the Indo-European fragmentation has been 4000 BC for some time, said linguist Dr Merritt Ruhlen.
语言学家梅里特·鲁伦博士说，传统上长期将印欧语的分化定在公元前4000年前后。
He said the new method ‘seems pretty reasonable’ and should be useful in tracing back the earlier history of the Indo-European language.
他认为，这种新方法“似乎颇为合理”，应有助于追溯印欧语更早的历史。
paragraphs.gist: 新模型推算的印欧语分化及大陆与岛屿分支分离时间比传统说法早很多，但误差范围也很大，语言学家对其追溯价值持审慎看法。

paragraphs.brief: 语言扩散与农业传播说
sentences: Specialists have long debated which country was the homeland of the Indo-Europeans, and whether their language was spread by conquest or because its speakers were the first agriculturists whose methods and tongue were adopted by other populations.
专家长期争论，印欧人的故乡在哪里，以及他们的语言究竟是随征服传播，还是因为他们率先务农，其他群体采纳其耕作方式的同时也接受了他们的语言。
The second theory, that it was spread by agriculture, has been advocated by archaeologist Dr Colin Renfrew.
考古学家科林·伦弗鲁博士主张第二种解释，即语言随农业传播。

Dr Forster, who works with Dr Renfrew, said in an interview that the suggested date 8100 BC for the arrival of Indo-European in Europe ‘does seem to vindicate Renfrew’s archaeological idea that the Indo-European languages were spread by farmers.’
曾与伦弗鲁合作的福斯特在采访中说，如果印欧语在公元前8100年左右进入欧洲，那么这个年代“似乎确实支持伦弗鲁的考古学观点，即印欧语是由农民传播的”。
Agriculture started to arrive in Europe from the Near East around 6000 BC, much earlier than the traditional date proposed by linguists for the spread of Indo- European.
约在公元前6000年，农业开始从近东传入欧洲，这比语言学家传统上主张的印欧语传播年代早得多。
This timing would fit with the lower end of Dr Forster’s range of dates.
这一时间与福斯特估算范围中靠近晚期的一端大致相符。
paragraphs.gist: 这些较早年代与农业从近东传入欧洲的时间较吻合，为语言随农民和耕作方式传播、而非单靠征服扩张的解释提供支持。

paragraphs.brief: 历史事件校准分支年代
sentences: Dr Forster said that his estimated date of 3200 BC for the arrival of Celtic speakers in the British Isles was also much earlier than the usual date, 600 BC, posited on the basis of archaeological evidence.
福斯特估计，说凯尔特语的人在公元前3200年已抵达不列颠群岛，远早于以往根据考古证据推定的公元前600年。

Dr Forster and Dr Toth said their method of evaluating groups of languages against each other was unfamiliar to historical linguists, many of whom restrict their research to how words in only one single language have changed over time.
两人指出，比较多个语言群体的方法并不为历史语言学家熟悉，后者中许多人只研究单一语言的词汇如何随时间变化。
Asked what linguists thought of his approach he said: ‘To be honest, they don’t understand it, most of them.
有人问语言学家怎么看他的方法，他回答：“说实话，他们大多不明白。
They don’t even know what I’m talking about.’
他们甚至不知道我在说什么。”
The method used by Dr Forster and Dr Toth has two parts.
Forster博士和Toth博士使用的方法有两个部分。
One is to draw a tree on the basis of carefully chosen words; the second is to date the splits in the tree by calibrating them with known historical events.
一是根据仔细挑选的词汇画出谱系树，二是用年代已知的历史事件校准树上各分支点，从而确定它们分化的时间。
This is similar to the way geneticists date their evolutionary trees by tying one or more branch points to known dates from the fossil record.
这与遗传学家为演化树定年的办法类似：将一个或多个分支点，与化石记录中年代已知的节点对应起来。
paragraphs.gist: 新方法先据精选词汇画出谱系，再用已知历史事件校准分支年龄，其凯尔特语入岛年代远早于考古估计，也有别于传统单语研究。

paragraphs.brief: 语言变化不规则影响定年
sentences: Dr April McMahon, a linguist at the University of Sheffield in England, said that Dr Forster’s method ‘seems to me to be a good start’, and that it was reasonable to base a language family tree on just a handful of well-chosen words.
英国谢菲尔德大学语言学家埃普丽尔·麦克马洪博士称，在她看来，福斯特的方法“是个好的开始”，仅凭少数精心挑选的词来建立语言家谱树是合理的。

She had less confidence in the dating method, she said, because language changes in an irregular way based on social factors like the size of the speaker’s group and its degree of contact with others.
不过，她对这种定年方法信心较低：语言变化并不规律，而会受使用者群体大小、与其他群体接触的程度等社会因素影响。
paragraphs.gist: 麦克马洪认可少量精选词可用于建立语族谱系，却怀疑能否可靠定年，因为人口规模和群体接触会使语言变化速率不规则。

items.en: a difference of opinion about where a group of languages originated
items.zh: 关于一个语族起源于何地的意见分歧。
items.why: 题干要的是“关于某一组语言起源地的不同看法”。段落 E 说 specialists have long debated which country was the homeland,正是“对起源地存在分歧” 的意思，因此选 E。其它段落要么讲方法，要么讲时间，不谈“哪国是故乡”的争论。

items.en: a reference to a mythological figure
items.why: 题干中的 mythological figure (神话人物) 在 A 段直接出现: Mars, the Roman god of war,是罗马神话中的战神，因此 15 对应 A。

items.en: an expression of one person’s doubt about a particular method of analysing scientific data
items.zh: 一个人对分析科学数据的具体方法表示怀疑
items.why: 题干强调“某个人表达出对某种分析科学数据方法的怀疑?。G 段中 McMahon 明说 she had less confidence in the dating method, x “ill 定年代”的分析方法持怀疑态度，完全对应这一点，所以选 G。

items.en: an explanation of how one particular Celtic language spread due to the movement of people
items.zh: 解释一种凯尔特语如何因人口流动而传播
items.why: 从康沃尔迁往法国布列塔尼的人带去了布列塔尼语，说明人口迁移如何传播一种凯尔特语。

items.en: a reason why some language experts distrust language trees
items.zh: 一些语言专家不信任语言谱系树的一个原因。
items.why: 题干问“某些语言专家为什么不信任语言树”。 C 段一上来就给出原因: because languages change so fast,因此他们 have little faith in language trees。这就是题干要找的“原因”,故答案为 C。

items.en: An approach commonly used in language research has too narrow a focus.
items.zh: 语言研究中常用的方法过于狭隘。
items.answer: A · Dr Peter Forster & Dr Alfred Toth
items.solution: 彼得·福斯特博士和阿尔弗雷德·托特博士

items.en: The number of people who use a language has an effect on the modifications the language undergoes.
items.zh: 使用某种语言的人数会影响这种语言如何演变。
items.solution: 艾普丽尔·麦克马洪博士

items.en: The Celtic language has been a distinct language for longer than experts previously thought.
items.zh: 凯尔特语作为独立语言存在的时间，比专家以前认为的更长。
items.answer: A · Dr Peter Forster & Dr Alfred Toth
items.solution: 彼得·福斯特博士和阿尔弗雷德·托特博士

items.en: The use of one family of languages may have become more extensive due to farming practices.
items.zh: 农耕活动可能使某个语族得到更广泛的传播。

items.en: The script on the bronze tablet discovered in Coligny in France was written in a form of Celtic called ________.
items.zh: 在法国科利尼出土的青铜板上，铭文使用一种叫作________的凯尔特语言写成。
items.why: 题干问“这种凯尔特语叫做什么”。A 段直接说 words were in Gaulish, a version of the Celtic language,故填 Gaulish。注意只要一个单词，首字母大写。

items.en: After the success of the Roman Empire in conquering many parts of Europe, ________ became one of the predominant languages.
items.zh: 罗马帝国征服欧洲许多地区后，________成了占主导地位的语言之一。
items.why: 题干说“罗马帝国征服后哪种语言成为主要语言之一"。B 段指出 Latin 和后续语言取代了 Celtic,说明拉丁语成为主导语言，因此答案是 Latin。

items.en: ________ is known to have occurred among the various versions of the Gaelic language around 3200 BC.
items.zh: 已知大约在公元前 3200 年，盖尔语的不同变体之间出现了________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“他们推算，印欧语在欧洲首次分化约在公元前8100年，上下浮动1900年；欧洲大陆与不列颠的盖尔语变体约在公元前3200年分化，上下浮动1500年”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: For social reasons, developments in languages are ________.
items.zh: 受社会因素影响，语言的发展变化呈现出________的特点。
items.why: 题干说“因为社会原因，语言发展的特点是怎样的"。G 段给出原因: language changes in an irregular way。把 in an 去掉，填形容词 irregular,与句子“developments in languages are irregular”语法正确。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

points: 题干中的 mythological figure (神话人物) 在 A 段直接出现: Mars, the Roman god of war,是罗马神话中的战神，因此 15 对应 A。
题干说“因为社会原因，语言发展的特点是怎样的"。G 段给出原因: language changes in an irregular way。把 in an 去掉，填形容词 irregular,与句子“developments in languages are irregular”语法正确。
clauses: In a published article, they say that …, it split into different branches leading to Celtic, Latin, Greek and English.
连接词 after 引出“soon after the ancestral Indo-European language arrived in Europe over 5,000 years ago”，说明主句的时间关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 after 把这一层关系补进去。
The researchers’ method even dates the points …, although the dates have a wide range of possibility.
“at which their language tree divides”修饰前面的 points。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 points，再把修饰信息接回主句。
